main_body: A low green hedge/bush block: a lighter green upper band over a darker green lower band, with scattered leaf-highlight dots
top_band: light green #689e63 rows 1-5 (about 5 rows) under a 1-row dark outline at row 0; it is followed by mid-dark green rows 6-10 and a dark base rows 11-14
evidence: The hedge is a flat rectangle split into a light upper band and a darker lower band. The light band is a leaf-colour change within one flat wall, not a distinct horizontal surface. There is no front-edge line and no eave shadow. The silhouette is a plain rectangle with no rounded canopy top. It reads as a front elevation with a lighter hat, and a bush shown from the front in only two value bands has no readable top surface.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile for the references. The outline is dark green and tinted (4% neutral), which is acceptable. Texture is limited to a few scattered light dots on two flat value bands, and the shape is a plain rectangle. It looks thinner and flatter than the references, which have per-material shading and varied forms.
